scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/wknd/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/wknd
  set jcr:title{String} to "WKND Sites Project"
end

set properties on authorizable(wknd-author-group)/profile
  set givenName to "WKND Author Group"
  set email to "wknd-author-group@wknd.com"
  set aboutMe to "Group for WKND project content authors."
end

set ACL for wknd-author-group
  allow jcr:read on /
end
create user wknd-author-user with path /home/users/wknd with password 123456

set properties on authorizable(wknd-author-user)/profile
  set givenName to "WKND"
  set familyName to "Author User"
  set email to "wknd-author-user@wknd.com"
  set aboutMe to "User for WKND project content authors."
end
